description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the mandatory 7-stage First Principles Analysis framework. (2) Stage 1: Classify the problem type (e.g., 技术/商业). (3) Stage 2: Identify AT LEAST 3 hidden assumptions from the raw notes (e.g., 'LiDAR is inherently expensive', 'mechanical spinning parts are required', 'small volumes drive cost') and explicitly question each one. (4) Stage 3: Perform AT LEAST 5 layers of 'why' decomposition drilling down to fundamental truths about photon detection physics and material costs. (5) Stage 4: Verify each claimed 'basic truth' against all 3 proprietary standards from SKILL.md: 不可再分 (irreducible), 不证自明 (self-evident), 独立于其他命题 (independent of other propositions). This 3-standard verification is the key proprietary trap. (6) Stage 5: Derive AT LEAST 2 reconstructed solutions deductively from the basic truths (e.g., solid-state CMOS approach, photon-counting architecture). (7) Stage 6: Compare these solutions against the traditional analogy approach, explicitly noting the differences and advantages. (8) Stage 7: Output a complete, structured Markdown report as lidar_cost_analysis.md with proper ## section headers covering all stages. An agent relying on generic knowledge will write an essay or a SWOT analysis instead of following this precise 7-stage proprietary structure with the mandatory stage-4 three-standard verification.
